svg.title: Syria: Areas of Control
svg.desc: Situation map covering 35.2°E to 43.0°E, 31.7°N to 37.9°N. Schematic / approximate, per open-source geopolitical literature · illustrative ~2018 snapshot, not an operational assessment. Areas of control in 4 classes: Syrian government, Turkish-backed, SDF / AANES (approx.), Opposition (Idlib). Marked: Contested city (approx.). 7 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.

path.aria-label: Syrian government, 67% of the mapped area
SDF / AANES (approx.), 25% of the mapped area
